description: Lane A: personal brand, drafted in Eden. Pop-culture hook plus operational authority. Birch is Tuesday-only; Wed-Sat imagery belongs to The Coach.

unverified_claim.instructions: States a metric, result, or outcome that is NEITHER reported first-hand from the author's own work or measurement, NOR attributed to a named source. A first-person report of what the author personally measured or observed is sourced and is NOT a violation; an unattributed claim about the industry, a third party, or 'studies' is.

banned_words.instructions: Uses any of: unlock, empower, synergy, leverage, disrupt, hustle, utilize, iterate, optimize

hook_strength.instructions: How strongly does the opening line earn the next line
criteria: Stops the scroll and names a real tension

birch_present.instructions: The post uses the Birch mascot or its sign-off

is_tuesday_slot.instructions: The post is explicitly written for the Tuesday slot

operational_authority.instructions: Behind the hook there is a real operational point drawn from doing the work, not just a motivational sentiment

register_fit.instructions: The tone matches a warm, wry, Ted Lasso-adjacent register rather than a hard-sell or guru voice

rules.reason: hook with no operational substance underneath
